_README: Q116: reconversion of ONLY 1 label (5, genioglossus_r) out of vhf_hyoid_muscles_cryo.nii.gz's
full set, at --smooth 0.0 instead of ct_vhf_hyoid's own 1.0. Measured directly: raw voxel mask
main_frac 1.000 (1 component), and unlike geniohyoid_l/hyoglossus_r (Q114, investigated and
declined -- their pre-decimation mesh stayed fragmented at EITHER smoothing value, a marching-
cubes surface defect, not a smoothing bug), genioglossus_r's own pre-decimation mesh is ALSO
1.000/1 component at smooth=0 (vs 0.885/2 components at the current smooth=1.0) -- a clean
sciatic_n-class smoothing bug, not the third failure mode. Quadric decimation on the smooth=0
mesh preserves it exactly (1.000), so this id is ALSO added to SHEET_IDS in
export_viewer_bundle.py. Shipped bundle: 0.873 -> see PROJECT_STATE.md Q116 entry for the
actual verified figure. hyoglossus_l (label 17, same source subject) was re-measured too and
shows no comparable gain (0.823-0.835 at either smoothing value) -- left OUT of this mapping,
still comes from ct_vhf_hyoid unchanged. Listed BEFORE ct_vhf_hyoid in export_viewer_bundle.py's
--subject order so it claims just this one atlas_id, leaving the other ~9 muscles in
vhf_hyoid_muscles_cryo.nii.gz (and their own smooth=1.0 conversion) completely untouched.
genioglossus_r does NOT reach the male via any transfer -- vhm_rebuild_bundle.sh's own
xfer_vhf2vhm_neck deliberately excludes genioglossus_r/l (Q91: he has his own CT-derived
version, ct_vhm_ggl) -- so this fix is FEMALE ONLY, no male-side change expected or needed.
subject: ct_vhf_hyoid_fix
